dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Deeply concave trailing edge exhibiting a sharp falcate curve from the apex to the posterior insertion point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphology with a moderate pixel radius at the highest vertical point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Linear anterior margin rising at an approximate 42-degree angle relative to the horizontal base chord.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.3:1, with the longitudinal base width exceeding the vertical height.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive depigmented mottled scarring and irregular light-colored patches across the lateral surface; small indentation or notch visible on the lower trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinct high-contrast mottled texture and reflective surface sheen throughout the central region of the fin.
